newsitem.title: USA: Miami air cargo volumes up 18 pct in August.
newsitem.headline: Miami air cargo volumes up 18 pct in August.

text.p: Cargo volumes at Miami International Airport(MIA) were up 18 percent in August, Dade County Aviation Department officials said Monday.

"This year has really stayed quite strong," said Peter Cajigal, MIA's chief of cargo development. The big August increase in cargo could be traced to strong exports to Latin America, especially Brazil and Chile, he said.
Total cargo, including mail, amounted to 166,730 tons at Miami International Airport during August.
International cargo, including mail, was 134,311 tons, up 18.45 percent over August 1995. Domestic cargo amounted to 32,419 tons, up 16.31 percent over August a year ago.
For the year to date total cargo reached 1,217,522 tons, a 9.08 percent gain from the cargo handled by MIA in the first eight months of last year.
"We are now getting into the heavy season," said Cajigal, and "we have high hopes for continued big increases." --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 8982 Fax +44 171 542 5017
